build_criterion_with_alignment: build a fairseq criterion that combines label smoothed cross entropy loss with alignment loss for training
create_alignment_config: create a LabelSmoothedCrossEntropyCriterionWithAlignmentConfig dataclass with a custom alignment_lambda weight value
compute_alignment_loss: compute the alignment loss from attention probabilities and source-target index pairs in a sample
register_criterion_label_smoothed: register the label_smoothed_cross_entropy_with_alignment criterion with fairseq using the register_criterion decorator
reduce_metrics_alignment: reduce and aggregate logging outputs including alignment loss across data parallel training workers
